assessment.conclusion: The wrapper requires exact single-phase authority and successful same-run/subset/freeze predecessors. Root counts, budgets, six controls, suspended creation, assignment before resume, restricted inherited handles, child acknowledgement, timeout shutdown, original-handle cleanup, final job-zero evidence and retained failures are supported. Raw process sidecars precede receiptArtifact annotations; completion is published only after preservation/output checks succeed.

All nine settings roles are observed and compared. Source, staged source, fixtures and project-plugin membership are preserved across phases. Temporary, DDC, logs, reports and artifact routes are owned. Known-Documents observations explicitly retain their logical-path limitation. The 20 GiB prerequisite, phase deadlines and retained-output caps are represented honestly; caps are not continuous OS quotas.

The pinned acquisition, static Release/C++20/MD recipe, explicit compiler/SDK/tool selection, normalized CMake paths, disabled install/test/tool/contrib/format routes, verified header/library/license copies and same-run receipts agree. ModuleRules validates selected UBT tools and copied identities while retaining read locks. Parser/probe NoPCHs and explicit NoVFS support direct module definitions and stage-owned response paths. Actual compile/link flags remain required observations.

The inherited selector defaults and false dependency-ignore hook were joined to the concrete target constructor, attributed INI/XML/command-line assignment gates, target-type overrides and Windows finalization. The dedicated constructor adds E04ProfileProof; the receipt serializes rules overrides separately from BuildPlugins. Runtime receipt selection, command-line-before-target configuration and enabled-module loading were distinguished from selected membership. Private configuration contents and actual runtime selections remain unknown until execution.

The public boundary exposes UE-owned values and a synchronous noexcept API. The eight suites, 38-ID union and 45 attempts agree with the fixtures and wrapper. Independent boundary recipes cover all five inclusive quotas. Input SHA256 sealing, auxiliary native SHA1, typed refusals, lifetime checks, repeated-attempt paths and evaluated custom checks are kept distinct. Editor exceptions are globally enabled and OR-combined with module requests; the probe's local false does not disable them. Compiler guards and response checks require the actual A1E mode.

errorsAndRecoveries: Initial combined policy/coverage output and oversized metadata projections were truncated. Smaller reads, complete source ranges and complete descriptor comparisons recovered the material content; no truncated source read was counted complete.
An absent policy records field was initially rendered with a synthesized null. It was reread as present=false with no value; that null was not treated as source data.
An intermediate PowerShell projection flattened singleton selectedRanges arrays. Direct-assignment rereads restored the arrays and their order.
A null optional field-list entry caused a Contains query error. Explicit permitted-field reads recovered the relevant record-13 data.

An incorrect assumption that closure sourceBindings contained top-level paths caused a query failure. Its actual file/excerpt/symbols/ranges representation was inspected and all 81 identities were checked. The 27 record-5 bindings and 81 closure rows were not treated as identical representations.
One slow read-only descriptor join yielded without captured session metadata; its incomplete output was not relied upon. An indexed replacement completed successfully.
No source execution, build, test, YAML parsing, GUI/network/GitHub action, mutation, saved file, delegation, resume/fork or memory tool use occurred.
